nodes.name: Corrosion-driven Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH formation
nodes.procedure: The Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF is synthesized in just 1 h through immersing IF in a mixed solution containing NiCl₂ and Na₂S₂O₃ at room temperature and atmospheric pressure. (see Supporting Information for details)

unit_operations.name: Immersion
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: immersing IF in a mixed solution containing NiCl₂ and Na₂S₂O₃

unit_operations.name: Spontaneous corrosion
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: at room temperature and atmospheric pressure

nodes.source_text: The Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF is synthesized in just 1 h through immersing IF in a mixed solution containing NiCl₂ and Na₂S₂O₃ at room temperature and atmospheric pressure. (Figure 1a)

nodes.name: Na₂S₂O₃-only corrosion
nodes.procedure: Iron foam undergoes corrosion reactions in single Na₂S₂O₃ salt solution, exhibiting a typical orthorhombic FeOOH phase.
nodes.source_text: the sample reacted with Na₂S₂O₃ exhibits a typical orthorhombic FeOOH phase

nodes.name: NiCl₂-only corrosion
nodes.procedure: Iron foam undergoes corrosion reactions in single NiCl₂ salt solution, forming a NiFe-LDH phase.
nodes.source_text: the sample treated solely with NiCl₂ forms a NiFe-LDH phase

nodes.name: pH-adjusted Ni₃S₄ synthesis
nodes.procedure: The pH of the Na₂S₂O₃ etching solution is adjusted to obtain the Ni₃S₄ phase.
nodes.source_text: the pH of the Na₂S₂O₃ etching solution is adjusted to obtain the Ni₃S₄ phase

nodes.name: Ru-NiFe-LDH synthesis
nodes.procedure: RuNiFe-LDH is synthesized directly on IF via the same room-temperature corrosion strategy.
nodes.source_text: RuNiFe-LDH is also synthesized directly on IF via the same room-temperature corrosion strategy

The OER performance of Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF is evaluated in 1M KOH at 25°C in a three-electrode system... Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF achieves an overpotential of 250 mV at a current density of 200 mA cm⁻²... 500 mA cm⁻² at overpotentials as low as 297 mV... Tafel slope of 30.8 mV dec⁻¹
the catalyst exhibits low overpotentials of 297 mV in 1 M KOH and 326 mV in simulated seawater at 500 mA cm⁻²

nodes.description: OER stability in 1 M KOH at 500 mA cm⁻²
nodes.source_text: Stability tests show that Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF retains 96.5% OER stability after 100 h of operation at 500 mA cm⁻²

nodes.source_text: the OER durability of Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF is tested in simulated seawater. After 100 h of continuous operation at 500 mA cm⁻², the voltage increased by only 50 mV, maintaining 95% stability

At a cell voltage of 1.8 V in pure water, the AEMWE achieves current densities of 450, 566, 684, and 864 mA cm⁻² at 25°C, 40°C, 60°C, and 80°C, respectively... achieves an industrial-relevant current density of 1 A cm⁻² at just 1.85 V... stable for 1000 h at 80°C
Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF demonstrates superior performance, with overpotentials of 96, 257, and 389 mV required to achieve current densities of 10, 100, and 500 mA cm⁻², respectively.

nodes.evidence_snippet: as confirmed by the transmission electron microscopy (TEM) image (Figure 1d)

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows lattice fringes of 0.285 nm and 0.182 nm corresponding to (311) and (511) planes of Ni₃S₄, and 0.260 nm for (012) plane of NiFe-LDH, confirming heterostructure interface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image (Figure 1e) clearly shows lattice fringes with spacings of 0.285 and 0.182 nm, corresponding to the (311) and (511) planes of Ni₃S₄, respectively... lattice stripes with a spacing of 0.260 nm correspond to the (012) plane of NiFe-LDH

nodes.characterization_summary: AFM indicates Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH nanosheet thickness of 3.88 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The atomic force microscopy (AFM) image indicates that the thickness of the Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH nanosheets is about 3.88 nm (Figure 1f)

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM-EDS mappings show Ni, Fe, O, S, Cl distribution with sulfur enriched on surface and periphery of nanoclusters.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the STEM-based energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (STEM-EDS) mappings reveal the distribution of Ni, Fe, O, S, and Cl in the catalyst (Figure 1g). Notably, the sulfur content on the surface of the nanoclusters is high and primarily located at the periphery

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows Ni-S stretching modes at 217 cm⁻¹ and 276 cm⁻¹ for Ni₃S₄, Ni²⁺-O vibrations at 468 and 541 cm⁻¹ for NiFe-LDH/IF and Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman spectrum of S-FeOOH/IF exhibits a distinct Fe³⁺-O vibrational mode at 676 cm⁻¹. Both NiFe-LDH/IF and Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF show characteristic Ni²⁺-O vibrations at 468 and 541 cm⁻¹. Notably, Ni₃S₄/IF and Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF display additional signature bands at 217 cm⁻¹ and 276 cm⁻¹, attributable to Ni-S stretching modes in the Ni₃S₄ phase (Figure S9c,d)

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS of Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH shows positive binding energy shifts vs NiFe-LDH: Fe 2p₃/₂ +0.67 eV (Fe³⁺), +0.26 eV (Fe²⁺); Ni 2p₃/₂ +0.33 eV (Ni³⁺), +0.54 eV (Ni²⁺); Ni(III)/Ni(II) ratio 0.875 vs 0.733; S 2p at 162.30 eV (3/2) and 163.23 eV (1/2).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Compared to NiFe-LDH, the Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH composite exhibits positive binding energy shifts of 0.67 eV (Fe³⁺ 2p₃/₂) and 0.26 eV (Fe²⁺ 2p₃/₂) along with corresponding positive shifts of 0.33 eV (Ni³⁺ 2p₃/₂) and 0.54 eV (Ni²⁺ 2p₃/₂). These shifts indicate that electrons transfer from NiFe-LDH to Ni₃S₄... the Ni(III)/Ni(II) ratio increases from 0.733 in NiFe-LDH to 0.875 in Ni₃S₄/NiFe LDH... the S 2p spectrum displays two spin-orbit peaks, S 2p₃/₂ at 162.30 eV and S 2p₁/₂ at 163.23 eV confirming the presence of more Ni₃S₄ on the catalyst surface.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS depth profiling of Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF shows S content 22.1 at% at surface decreasing to 8.7 at% after 20 s etching; Fe increases from 9.2 at% to 21.6 at%; Ni stable at 19.5-20.3 at%; positive BE shift in Fe 2p and negative in Ni 2p with depth.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XPS depth profiling continues to investigate... for sulfur, the content at the outermost layer reaches 22.1 at% and gradually decreases to 8.7 at% after 20 s of etching... iron shows an opposite distribution trend. Its content increases from approximately 9.2 at% to 21.6 at% at 20 s of etching... nickel, its content remains relatively stable at approximately 19.5-20.3 at% across all depths

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES shows NiFe-LDH as Ni²⁺ similar to NiO; Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH as mixed Ni²⁺/Ni³⁺ valence. Fe K-edge shows Fe³⁺ in both with higher proportion in heterostructure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES)... In the Ni K-edge XANES spectra (Figure 2b), NiFe-LDH exhibits a Ni²⁺ oxidation state similar to that of NiO, while the Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH heterostructure displays a mixed-valence state comprising both Ni²⁺ and Ni³⁺... For the Fe K-edge (Figure 2c), both Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH and NiFe-LDH exhibit Fe in the Fe³⁺ oxidation state

nodes.characterization_summary: R-space EXAFS shows positive shift in Ni-O path and Ni-S/O bonds in Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH; stable Fe-O with positive Fe-M shift; enhanced Ni-M and weakened Fe-M signals in WT analysis.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the R-space EXAFS analysis of Ni (Figure 2e), a noticeable positive shift in the Ni-O coordination path is observed in the Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH sample... the R-space EXAFS data (Figure 2f) reveal a stable Fe-O coordination in Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH, whereas the Fe-M scattering path exhibits a positive shift... An enhanced Ni-M signal in Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH (Figure 2h,i)... the Fe-M signal is significantly weakened in the heterostructure (Figure 2k,l)

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando Raman shows structural reconstruction at lower potentials; initial peaks at 350, 462, 541 cm⁻¹ diminish, new peaks at 475, 559 cm⁻¹ (γ-NiOOH), 685 cm⁻¹ (FeOOH), and 981 cm⁻¹ (SO₄²⁻) emerge.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Comparative analysis of operando Raman spectra reveals that Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF undergoes structural reconstruction at lower potentials... Initially, the Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF spectrum exhibits three characteristic peaks at 350 cm⁻¹ (NiS stretching), 462 cm⁻¹ (Ni²⁺-O bending), and 541 cm⁻¹ (lattice vibrations)... replaced by new peaks at 475 and 559 cm⁻¹, uniquely assigned to the Eg and A₁g vibrational modes of γ-NiOOH... 685 cm⁻¹ peak confirms the in situ formation of FeOOH... characteristic SO₄²⁻ Raman peak at 981 cm⁻¹

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED illustrates generation of Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH heterogeneous structures.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The selected area electron diffraction (SAED) image further illustrates the generation of heterogeneous structures (Figure S3).
